# @atsh/env

> 标签: aes-gcm, argon2id, atsh, config, dotenv, e2e-encryption, env, secrets, vault, zero-knowledge

## 简介

Zero-knowledge secret manager SDK. Every project has its own master pass; the server stores only ciphertext it cannot read.

- 官网：https://env.atsh.in
- 源码仓库：git+https://github.com/atsh-here/atsh-env.git
